market_note: Equity futures broadly lower, Nasdaq futures off more than 2%; crude up about 1% near $98 while Treasury yields drop.
summary: Stocks are falling Thursday as Meta earnings dent AI optimism and oil prices climb. The Nasdaq is down over 2% and the VIX is spiking more than 15% as traders rotate into haven bonds.
